In message <c5IP8.14341$U7.1...@vixen.cso.uiuc.edu>, Jon Stahler

<sta...@ilir.uiuc.edu> writes:
>> It will be announced when it is available.
>>
>The set is still coming out next month, right?

Next month is July. The press release says August.

This may also turn out to be the end of August, for example. This would
leave the set to be about ten weeks away, approximately. Starting
previews ten weeks before may be considered premature.

Something along the lines of twice weekly-ish previews, one of each of
the main Camarilla clans - a new vampire, maybe, or a new library card
that works well with that clan - may have some utility, running up to
any pre-release tournaments White Wolf decides to run (or not).
